system: diamond-structure Ge, two-atom primitive cell of a cubic or tetragonally strained crystal; PBE; SG15 ONCV norm-conserving pseudopotentials (fully relativistic for spin-orbit runs, scalar-relativistic otherwise); Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x (and bands.x for symmetry labels) on 2 MPI ranks

fields.kind: "pw" (the only kind): a self-consistent pw.x run at the given geometry, optionally followed by a non-self-consistent band calculation at agent-chosen k points
fields.a_par_A: in-plane lattice parameter a of the conventional cell (x and y cube edges), Angstrom
fields.c_A: out-of-plane lattice parameter c of the conventional cell (z cube edge), Angstrom; c = a_par is the cubic crystal
fields.spin_orbit: true: noncollinear spinors with spin-orbit coupling, fully relativistic file Ge_ONCV_PBE_FR-1.0.upf; false: scalar-relativistic, spin-degenerate run with the scalar-relativistic file of the same SG15 family, Ge_ONCV_PBE-1.0.upf
fields.ecutwfc_Ry: wavefunction cutoff; the charge-density cutoff is 4 x ecutwfc (norm-conserving)
fields.kmesh: n of an n x n x n Monkhorst-Pack mesh in the reciprocal vectors of the primitive cell
fields.kshift: 0: mesh contains Gamma; 1: mesh offset by half a step along each reciprocal vector
fields.occupations: "fixed" (insulator filling: the lowest 28 spinor bands, or 14 doubly occupied scalar bands, are filled at every k point) or "smearing" (Marzari-Vanderbilt cold smearing)
fields.degauss_Ry: smearing width; null for fixed occupations
fields.band_kpoints_inverse_A: list of 0 to 30 k points [kx, ky, kz], Cartesian, in inverse Angstrom including the factor 2 pi (Gamma = [0, 0, 0]); when non-empty a non-self-consistent band calculation on the converged density returns all band energies at each of them
fields.symmetry_labels: true: classify the bands at each band k point by the irreducible representations of its little group (bands.x, double groups when spin_orbit is true); requires a non-empty band_kpoints_inverse_A. false otherwise

charge.rule: units = max(1, ceil((N_k * scf_factor + [band_run_overhead + N_band * band_factor if band k points are requested]) / seconds_per_unit)), where N_k is the number of symmetry-distinct k points pw.x uses for the SCF mesh of this cell (returned as charged_k_points; a tetragonal cell has about twice as many as the cubic one) and N_band the number of band k points; the factors are approximate seconds per k point on the lab's 2 cores, so one unit is about one minute. Requests above max_units_per_request are refused without charge.

spin_orbit.family: SG15 ONCV norm-conserving, fully relativistic (Scherpelz, Govoni, Hamada, Galli 2016, built with the SG15 1.0 parameters)

scalar.family: SG15 ONCV norm-conserving, scalar-relativistic (Schlipf and Gygi 2015)

result_units.stress_GPa: pw.x sign convention: the negative of the Cauchy stress, so that pressure_GPa = trace/3 (positive when the cell is compressed); Cartesian axes of the conventional cell
result_units.band_energies_eV: eV on the absolute pw.x scale of that run (only differences within one run are meaningful); spin_orbit runs list every spinor band (Kramers pairs appear twice), scalar runs every spin-degenerate band once
result_units.mesh_point_nearest_gamma: all band energies at the point of the SCF mesh closest to Gamma (Gamma itself when kshift = 0)
result_units.symmetry_labels: bands.x output: for each band k point, the point group of its little group and, for each group of degenerate bands, the band indices (1-based), energy and irreducible-representation name as printed by bands.x
